map.计算腰臀比 WHR：WHR = 腰围 / 臀围（均取水平最粗处 cm）。男性 ≥: Compute WHR = waist / hip (both at the widest horizontal point, in cm). For men ≥0.9 and women ≥0.85 indicates central (apple) obesity with elevated cardiovascular/metabolic risk.
map.结合腰高比 WHtR 与 BMI：工具同时给腰高比 = 腰围 / 身高，>0.5: Combines waist-height ratio WHtR and BMI: the tool also gives WHtR = waist / height, where >0.5 suggests excess visceral fat; combined with BMI it reflects abdominal fat more sensitively than BMI alone.
map.男女性别阈值差异：男性刻度 0.7-1.2、女性 0.65-1.1；男性风险档：: Sex threshold differences: male scale 0.7-1.2, female 0.65-1.1; male risk bands <0.9 low, 0.9-1.0 moderate, >1.0 high; female <0.85 low, 0.85-0.95 moderate, >0.95 high.

map.为什么腰臀比比 BMI 更能反映风险？: Why does WHR reflect risk better than BMI?
map.BMI 不区分脂肪分布，而腹部（内脏）脂肪与代谢疾病关系更密切。同样 BMI 的: BMI does not distinguish fat distribution, while abdominal (visceral) fat is more closely tied to metabolic disease. At the same BMI, an apple shape (abdominal obesity) carries higher risk than a pear shape, which WHR/WHtR captures.
map.量腰围的正确位置？: What is the correct position for measuring the waist?
map.站立、自然呼吸，软尺绕肚脐上方约 1-2cm（或肋骨下缘与髂嵴中点）水平一周，取: Stand with natural breathing, wrap the tape horizontally about 1-2 cm above the navel (or midway between the lower rib and the iliac crest), read at the end of exhalation, without holding breath or sucking in the abdomen. Measure the hip at its most protruding point horizontally.
